item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00263","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C01","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C07 is the direct prior-year almond-fee proclamation expressly identified in the child and supplies its core drafting template. Both directives use the same section 22 investigation-and-finding sequence, describe the identical almond products, apply fees to entries or warehouse withdrawals during a specified crop-year period, cap the fee at 50 percent ad valorem, and make it additional to other duties. The child adapts C07 by updating the period, aggregate thresholds, and graduated fees. C01 and C03 share section 22 import-control machinery and some operative phrasing, but concern supplemental cotton quotas and are substantially less specific.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"in accordance with the Commission's recommendation in the said report of November 28, 1951, on December 10, 1951 I issued a proclamation ... imposing a fee on imports of shelled almonds and on blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds","parent_excerpt":"do hereby impose and proclaim a fee ... on any shelled almonds and on any blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste)","explanation":"The child expressly identifies and continues the exact earlier proclamation represented by C07."},{"child_excerpt":"shelled almonds, blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste) are practically certain to be imported ... under such conditions and in such quantities as to render or tend to render ineffective, or materially interfere with","parent_excerpt":"shelled almonds and blanched, roasted, or otherwise prepared or preserved almonds (not including almond paste) are practically certain to be imported ... under such conditions and in such quantities as to render or tend to render ineffective, or materially interfere with","explanation":"This is distinctive, nearly verbatim product-specific findings language."},{"child_excerpt":"entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption during the period October 1, 1952 to September 30, 1953 ... Provided, That in neither case shall the fee be in excess of 50 per centum ad valorem","parent_excerpt":"entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption during the period from October 1, 1951, to September 30, 1952 ... 10 cents per pound but not more than 50 per centum ad valorem","explanation":"The child reuses the same crop-year fee mechanism and adjusts its dates, quantities, and fee tiers."},{"child_excerpt":"The fees imposed by this proclamation shall be in addition to any other duties imposed on the importation of the articles subject to such fees.","parent_excerpt":"The fee imposed by this proclamation shall be in addition to any other duty imposed on the importation of the articles subject to such fee.","explanation":"The concluding substantive clause is essentially copied, with only singular/plural changes."}]}
